subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Subtitle Revolution
description: Learn The Subtitle Revolution in one minute.

hook.text: For decades, American audiences refused to read subtitles. Streaming changed that.

buildup.text: Young viewers grew up watching anime and K-dramas with subtitles.

discovery.text: Subtitle quality matters enormously. Poor translations can ruin a show.

twist.text: Dubbing is growing faster than subtitles in some markets.

climax.text: The subtitle revolution opened the floodgates for international television.

punchline.text: Reading subtitles was the price of admission to the world's stories.

quiz.question: What drove the increase in subtitle usage among American audiences?
options: Younger viewers grew up watching anime and K-dramas, removing the stigma around reading while watching
